d:
Eighteen years ago, the Yamaha R15 gave a whole generation of Indian motorcycling enthusiasts their first taste of track riding. Today, Yamaha’s R-lineup in India finally grows up with the all-new Yamaha R2.
We got 20 frantic minutes at the Madras International Circuit (MIC) to put the new R2 through its paces. Is a 204cc, DOHC, linear motor without VVA enough to wear the iconic R badge? How does the new Diamond chassis hold up compared to the legendary Deltabox layout? And most importantly, if you’re an R15 owner looking to upgrade, should you put your money down?
